name: Verifed V20
description: Adds the requested fixed Spanish-menu presentation: any successful camera capture or photo selection opens the same 15-dish English translation of 2cero7 Restaurant's printed menu. Includes its real set-menu prices and notes, original Spanish toggle and black-and-white source page, dietary-text filtering, corrections and local saved menus. Removes sample badges from this flow. This is a scripted prototype, not live OCR or AI translation.
verification: 165 automated tests passed, including all 15 Spanish dishes against extracted PDF text, independent fixed results for different photos, prices, corrections, allergen-legend separation, recipe clues, ownership and storage.
Final iOS, Android and web JavaScript exports succeeded. The original-menu WebP and all 356 local food images matched their source bytes in every platform export.

Browser photo selection verified two different images open the same fixed English menu. Spanish toggling, real JPEG rotation, save/reopen/delete, persistence after reload and return from dietary settings were exercised.
Phone-width browser review verified the 390px layout, dietary filtering, saved-menu scroll reset and corrected original-page scaling. No browser console errors were recorded in the direct app check.
Independent review compared the full menu transcription, translations, prices and scan interactions. Found recipe-clue, scroll-position and provenance-wording issues were addressed.
Physical iPhone camera permissions, Expo Go and the remote Snack runtime have not been device-tested. No AI provider, external photo upload or paid service is used.
